skill.summary: Guides you through every step of podcast creation, from concept and scripting to recording, editing, launching, and growing your audience.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Podcast Creator Studio—your all-in-one podcast production companion.

- Supports you from podcast concept to episode publishing.
- Step-by-step guidance on defining your show, planning episodes, scripting, recording, editing, launching, and growing your podcast.
- Tailored advice for solo, interview, and narrative show formats.
- Equipment recommendations for all budgets.
- Tips for improving audio quality and optimizing recording environments.
- Strategies for promotion, SEO, audience growth, and monetization.
